feeds.title: Dachshund Health
feeds.description: The Health and Welfare website of the Dachshund Breed Council and registered Charity, Dachshund Health UK. Find out all about Dachshunds, and information for buyers, owners, vets, and judges.

feeds.title: Low Rider Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Saving Little Dogs with Loving Hearts and Big Attitudes

feeds.title: You Did What With Your Wiener
feeds.description: 'You Did What With Your Wiener?' is a blog by Jessica, a former scientist, dedicated to promoting an active and healthy lifestyle for Dachshunds. She offers advice on hiking, camping, and traveling safely with small dogs. Jessica aims to dispel common myths about small dog capabilities and emphasizes proper care and adventure for Dachshunds. The blog also documents her journey with her own dogs and engages a community of like-minded Dachshund lovers through various interactive features.

feeds.title: Dachshund Friends Blog
feeds.description: Dachshund Friends is a blog for the dachshund owner or sausage dog enthusiast. Everything you need to know about sausage dog ownership, from a fellow dachshund owner. This is also a place where the creator shares information about the breed, learnings from the first few years of owning a dachshund, tips on choosing a dog, great products for your dog, places to visit with your dachshund - or other dog friends, without being biased!

feeds.title: Sunsong Dachshunds
feeds.description: We are Sue and Ian Search, and we own the Sunsong Dachshunds. Our website was created in 1996 to be your first choice for news, views, photos, show results, and information about UK Wirehaired Dachshunds in particular, and Dachshunds in general.

feeds.title: For My Dachshund Blog
feeds.description: Tips and advice from Dachshund lovers to Dachshund lovers on For My Dachshund Blog! We aim to answer the most frequent questions about Dachshunds whether asked to us personally by Dachshund lovers or because they are the most commonly searched questions through Google.

feeds.title: The Red Foundation
feeds.description: If you want to know more about what we are up to, including the Latest dachshunds up for adoption, events, in-office gossip, and more! Our primary mission at The Red Foundation is to protect the health and well-being of every dog in our care, and this is very important to us.

feeds.title: I Love Dachshunds
feeds.description: Answering the most asked Dachshund questions to help you take care of your dog and learn more about the breed. iLoveDachshunds.com is a website dedicated to all things dachshunds. We aim to answer the most popular dachshund questions and review the best dog products and services on the market. It's as simple as that!

feeds.title: Dachshund Station Blog
feeds.description: Dachshund Station is an online resource dedicated to Dachshunds and their parents. Check out our Dachshund Blog for the best training guides, care tips, and nutrition advice for your doxie.

feeds.title: Dachshund Rescue of Utah
feeds.description: A charity organization with the Pitman Animal Rescue Foundation, the Dachshund Rescue of Utah (DRUT) is working to make a difference in the lives of dachshunds in Utah. We aim to reduce the number of dachshunds in, and being euthanized by, Utah shelters and to provide well-educated and dedicated families and homes for homeless dachshunds.

feeds.title: Dachshund Bonus
feeds.description: Hello there! This is Jenny, creator of Dashchund Bonus and a dachshund lover and caring dachshunds are my passion. I create this blog to collect knowledge about all dachshund breeds around the world and share them with you.

feeds.title: Kalyxcornucopia
feeds.description: This a blog about a happy-go-lucky little dachshund named Baxter and sometimes his crafty mom! Kalyxcornucopia is a tiny world where little doxies, toyfriends, and crafts happily coexist.

feeds.title: Dogs Lovers Blog » Dachshund
feeds.description: Know all about the Dachshund breed through us! The Best Dogs Lovers Blog Ever is about helping us live a better life with our dogs. As well as to help connect pet owners all over. DogsLoversBolg aims to be one of the only dedicated dog news sources. This includes dogs in the media, product recalls, celebrity dogs, and anything else in the news that involves dogs.

feeds.title: Bicontinental Dachshund
feeds.description: Bicontinental Dachshund is a blog created for people who love to know about the Dachshund breed and how to take care of them! This blog has information and blog on all the Dachshund dogs like Tootsie, Truffle, and more informing about their day-to-day life, and memoirs.

feeds.title: My Dachshund Online Blog
feeds.description: My Dachshund Online is solely owned and run by me, Naomi Jones. My Dachshund Online is an online shop dedicated to dachshunds and their owners with everything for you and your furry friend. We aim to bring you great new products regularly with a focus on locally made items from local businesses.
